prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='FT_catboost', recommended_method='best_per_horizon_by_validation'. Narrative: THETA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while FT_catboost leads in seasonal capture (0.813) and overall RMSE (25.05). High model disagreement (rmse_spread=50.03) and divergent early/late horizon specialists warrant per-horizon selection to exploit complementary strengths across the forecast window.
